integrity: Exact exhaustive integer-Morse certificate included; full finite acyclicity and boundary reductions; no independent audit.
scientific_limitations: The classification is for one finite Johnson graph at one Čech scale. Higher-scale persistence, equivariant splitting and general Johnson parameters are not determined; equivalent unindexed prior work is possible.
title: Integral homotopy of the scale-two Čech nerve of \(J(6,3)\)
